availableCommands.name: google-workspace
availableCommands.description: Read this before the first Google Drive, Docs, Sheets or Slides connector call whenever the task creates or changes a Google file. Use this skill whenever the user wants to create or change a Google Doc, Sheet or Slides file in their Google Drive. Triggers include: a request that names Google Docs, Sheets, Slides or Drive and asks to make, edit, format, copy or rename a file; a docs.google.com link with a request to change that file, even a one-line fix or suggested edits; and any follow-up change to a Google file from earlier in the chat, even "change it" or "add a tab". Includes helper scripts for document positions, cell ranges and slide layout. However, if the user asks for a doc, deck or spreadsheet without naming Google, or gives a Google file only as source material for something new, use Claude's own output type instead. Do NOT use for read-only questions about a Google file, or for Word, Excel, PowerPoint or PDF files.

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P07.3 — Impersonation на портах с профилями и двойным аудитом

**Intent:** Перевести support impersonation на доменные порты (`ImpersonationGrantStore`, `ImpersonationAuditSink`) и контракты фреймворка, ввести профили `dev|standard|regulated` с правилами в атомарном claim, писать аудит в central и в tenant с отказом при любом сбое и обнулить runtime-globals baseline.

**Why:** D96 A (п.1–п.5); D70 п.9 — baseline Impersonation обязан стать нулевым в P07; F00 A11.1 — сервис на фасадах. Внешняя практика: короткий just-in-time grant, второй утверждающий для чувствительного режима, два коррелированных журнала, отказ при невозможности аудита (W6).

**Scope Included:** kernel `Audit/Contracts/SynchronousAuditWriter` (Spi Implement), `Audit/Internal/DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter`, AuditRegistrar factory и тесты штатного writer; `CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\{ImpersonationGrantStore,ImpersonationAuditSink}` (Spi Implement); `Impersonation\Data\{GrantClaim,ClaimedGrant,ImpersonationAuditEvent}`; `Impersonation\Enums\ImpersonationProfile`; `Impersonation\Internal\{DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore,DualImpersonationAuditSink}`; переписанный `DatabaseImpersonationService` (зависимости examples §7c, порядок D96 п.5); scoped `ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard` с экземплярным `allowing()`; `ImpersonationPolicy(enabled, profile)`; config `corex-tenancy.impersonation.profile` (default `standard`) вместо `require_approved_by`; `packages/tenancy/src/Internal/DangerousModesCheck.php` (опасный режим `dev`); текст `ImpersonationRestrictedException`; `scripts/runtime-globals-baseline.json` → `{}`; тесты `ImpersonationProfileTest`, `ImpersonationAuditTest`, перевод `ImpersonationTest`, `ImpersonationWriteGuardTest`; `configuration.md`, tenancy README; Golden delta P07.3.

**Scope Excluded:** изменение схемы `root_impersonation_grants`/`root_account_events` (P08); UI выдачи/утверждения grant; consent tenant-администратора; маскирование данных в режиме support; L1/L3 уровни write-guard (без изменения).

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D100-p07-grok-design-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D98-p07-design-audit-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md` (A) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` (§1.3, §2, §3.3, §4, §5) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design-rag.md` (W6) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` (§7, §7c, §8) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/facts/impersonation.txt` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D69-p05-config-contract.md` (п.7, п.10) · результат P07.2 (`plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.2-execution/completion.md`, появляется после его исполнения)

**Files:** `packages/core/src/Audit/Contracts/SynchronousAuditWriter.php`, `packages/core/src/Audit/Internal/DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter.php`, `packages/core/src/Audit/Laravel/AuditRegistrar.php`, `packages/core/tests/**` (SynchronousAuditWriter persistence/transaction tests), `packages/core/README.md`; `packages/tenancy/CHANGELOG.md`, `packages/core/CHANGELOG.md`; `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Contracts/{ImpersonationGrantStore,ImpersonationAuditSink}.php`, `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Data/{GrantClaim,ClaimedGrant,ImpersonationAuditEvent}.php`, `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Enums/ImpersonationProfile.php`, `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Internal/{DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore,DualImpersonationAuditSink}.php`, `packages/tenancy/src/Internal/DangerousModesCheck.php` (новые); `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Internal/{DatabaseImpersonationService,ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard}.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Internal/Models/ImpersonationGrant.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/Support/{ImpersonationPolicy,TenancyOptions}.php`; `packages/tenancy/src/Laravel/{RuntimeRegistrar,EventsRegistrar,AuthenticationRegistrar}.php`; `packages/tenancy/config/corex-tenancy.php`; `packages/core/src/Context/Exceptions/ImpersonationRestrictedException.php`; `scripts/runtime-globals-baseline.json`; `packages/tenancy/tests/Feature/{ImpersonationTest,ImpersonationWriteGuardTest,ImpersonationAuditTest}.php`, `packages/tenancy/tests/Pg/ImpersonationProfileTest.php`; `docs/architecture/configuration.md`, `packages/tenancy/README.md`; `packages/{tenancy,core}/resources/contracts/php-api.json`; `tests/Golden/baseline/*` (строки P07.3 из §4); `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.3-execution/**`.

**Required Reads:** 1) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` §1.3, §3.3; 2) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` §7–§8; 3) `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md`; 4) `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Internal/DatabaseImpersonationService.php`; 5) `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/Internal/ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard.php`; 6) `packages/notifications/src/Internal/DangerousModesCheck.php`; 7) `packages/core/src/Audit/Data/AuditEntry.php`; 8) `packages/tenancy/tests/Feature/ImpersonationTest.php`.

**Implementation Rules:** Правила профиля — только в WHERE атомарного claim (examples §8), без схемы. D100/ examples §7d: отдельный synchronous committed writer, без AuditLogger/queue/ImpersonationService; mandatory audit обходит auditEnabled, ambient transactions запрещены; central intent сохраняется при tenant failure, distributed rollback не обещается. Regulated approver EXISTS staff в том же claim UPDATE. Аудит fail-closed во всех профилях: сбой central или tenant-зеркала → `start` отказывает, сессия не открыта, grant остаётся использованным. Staff остаётся актором (`ActorType::Support`). Никаких фасадов, helper-функций, static-состояния в `Impersonation/**`; baseline только `{}`. `require_approved_by` удаляется без моста (D01). Manifest и changelog — в одном продуктовом commit; base SHA — до правок.

**Code Guidance:** Досье §3.3 шаги 1–8; examples §7 (порты и VO), §7c (конструктор и аудит), §8 (enum, SQL claim, матрица профилей, опасный режим).

**Validation:**
- После продуктового commit: `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh` и `bash scripts/contract-guard.sh "$(cat plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.3-execution/base-commit.txt)"` → exit 0.
- `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy test -- --group=pg --filter=ImpersonationProfile` → exit 0: все 27 ячеек матрицы examples §8.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy test -- --filter='Impersonation'` → exit 0: actual stock sink/writer: disabled general audit + async queue имеют committed rows до regenerate/login; central/tenant/commit/ambient transaction failure → отказ start без открытой сессии и consumed grant; central intent при tenant failure сохраняется; provider DI service→sink→writer и AuditLogger→service нецикличен; в `dev` зеркала нет; события started/ended/failed содержат профиль и `expires_at`; `allowing()` экземпляра восстанавливает guard после исключения; опасный режим `dev` в production без acknowledgement → violation, с acknowledgement — нет.
- `cat scripts/runtime-globals-baseline.json` → `{}`; `scripts/php84 composer runtime-globals-gate` → exit 0; негатив: добавить `now()` в `DatabaseImpersonationService` → exit ≠ 0, вернуть.
- `git grep -n -E 'require_approved_by|requireApprovedBy' -- packages docs` → пусто.
- `scripts/php84 composer --working-dir=packages/tenancy test`, `PGSQL_PORT=5434 scripts/php84 composer test:pg`, `scripts/php84 composer test:packages` → exit 0.
- `scripts/php84 php scripts/php-api.php --write` дважды → идентично; `scripts/php84 composer php-api`, `scripts/php84 composer bc-check` → exit 0; diff Golden — только строки P07.3 из досье §4.
- `scripts/php84 composer lint:check`, `scripts/php84 composer analyse` → exit 0; `bash scripts/anti-weakening-gate.sh` → exit 0; `php scripts/package-docs-gate.php` → exit 0.
- Review `light` (D97): self-check по досье §6; строка `review: self-check GREEN` в Completion Notes.

**Deliverables:** package changelogs; `artifacts/P07.3-execution/base-commit.txt` и candidate SHA; порты, профили, двойной аудит, экземплярный guard; baseline `{}`; тесты профилей и аудита; Golden delta P07.3; `artifacts/P07.3-execution/completion.md`.

## Bound candidate

# Review candidate

Read-only. Do not repair or start another review.

## Specification
### P07.3 — Impersonation на портах с профилями и двойным аудитом

**Intent:** Перевести support impersonation на доменные порты (`ImpersonationGrantStore`, `ImpersonationAuditSink`) и контракты фреймворка, ввести профили `dev|standard|regulated` с правилами в атомарном claim, писать аудит в central и в tenant с отказом при любом сбое и обнулить runtime-globals baseline.

**Why:** D96 A (п.1–п.5); D70 п.9 — baseline Impersonation обязан стать нулевым в P07; F00 A11.1 — сервис на фасадах. Внешняя практика: короткий just-in-time grant, второй утверждающий для чувствительного режима, два коррелированных журнала, отказ при невозможности аудита (W6).

**Scope Included:** kernel `Audit/Contracts/SynchronousAuditWriter` (Spi Implement), `Audit/Internal/DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter`, AuditRegistrar factory и тесты штатного writer; `CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\{ImpersonationGrantStore,ImpersonationAuditSink}` (Spi Implement); `Impersonation\Data\{GrantClaim,ClaimedGrant,ImpersonationAuditEvent}`; `Impersonation\Enums\ImpersonationProfile`; `Impersonation\Internal\{DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore,DualImpersonationAuditSink}`; переписанный `DatabaseImpersonationService` (зависимости examples §7c, порядок D96 п.5); scoped `ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard` с экземплярным `allowing()`; `ImpersonationPolicy(enabled, profile)`; config `corex-tenancy.impersonation.profile` (default `standard`) вместо `require_approved_by`; `packages/tenancy/src/Internal/DangerousModesCheck.php` (опасный режим `dev`); текст `ImpersonationRestrictedException`; `scripts/runtime-globals-baseline.json` → `{}`; тесты `ImpersonationProfileTest`, `ImpersonationAuditTest`, перевод `ImpersonationTest`, `ImpersonationWriteGuardTest`; `configuration.md`, tenancy README; Golden delta P07.3.

**Scope Excluded:** изменение схемы `root_impersonation_grants`/`root_account_events` (P08); UI выдачи/утверждения grant; consent tenant-администратора; маскирование данных в режиме support; L1/L3 уровни write-guard (без изменения).

**Inputs:** `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D100-p07-grok-design-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D98-p07-design-audit-remediation.md` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D96-p07-impersonation-access-edges.md` (A) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design.md` (§1.3, §2, §3.3, §4, §5) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/research/P07-design-rag.md` (W6) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/examples.md` (§7, §7c, §8) · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07-design/facts/impersonation.txt` · `plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/decisions/D69-p05-config-contract.md` (п.7, п.10) · результат P07.2 (`plans/2026.09.27-№1-COREX-KERNEL/artifacts/P07.2-execution/completion.md`, появляется после его исполнения)

**Implementation Rules:** Правила профиля — только в WHERE атомарного claim (examples §8), без схемы. 10→# D100 — p07-grok-design-remediation (accepted)

**Actor:** designer/codex, owner-authorized design repair via artifacts/P07-design-remediation/new-session-prompt.txt. Actual provider metadata is retained in this repair's provenance; no Task invocation or formal audit route is inferred.
**Evidence:** RAG:— findings/P07-grok-review.md findings 1–4, 6–7, installed Laravel/stancl, stock QueuedAuditLogger/RecordAuditEntry/AuditLog, SqlDigestBuilder, package-graph-gate/taxonomy; artifacts/P07-design-remediation/six-findings-proof.php and six-findings-proof.json. Baseline HEAD 4137d2412497aa9348cf19322b26f1d074b5ad2c.

## Solution

Scoped priority amendment of D95 p.2/4/6 and D96 p.1/4/5/7/10; D98/D99 otherwise remain effective. Historical decisions/findings are preserved. Product P07.1–P07.6 is not executed.

1. **Finding 1 / P07.1:** parse central connection with installed ConfigurationUrlParser in both CentralTemplateConnectionResolver and ConnectionBootstrapper, carry parsed password/options, remove url before authoritative tenant route overrides. Remove read/write overlays; stock template is a single route, replicas require a host resolver's explicit tenant-safe implementation. DatabaseConnectionConfig.options cannot carry url/driver/host/port/database/username/read/write. Acceptance includes URL credentials/query options, two tenant DBs plus central URL DB, host resolver override and negative routing options. Central config stays byte-identical.
20→2. **Finding 2 / P07.1:** SessionConnectionBootstrapper replaces already created handlers on the same Store, restores handlers/full config, and isolates file path/cache clone including Redis session.prefix. HTTP supports database/redis/memcached/file; redis/memcached use an explicit dedicated session.store separate from tenant stores and host store (driver match), Redis connection explicitly named. Unsupported session drivers fail options validation; stateless entry has no session middleware. HttpRegistrar priority: ResolveTenantFromHost before StartSession, ScopeSessionToTenant after it and before errors/auth middleware. StartSession save and session lock release precede end/revert. First account binding invalidates old attributes/auth and rotates token/id; mismatched marker denies. HTTP entry/exit flushes residual Store attributes and forgets auth guards for resident requests, without doing so during nested runFor/jobs. Preserve same-account login. Tests exercise live handlers, central cookie, A→B, same-A, response persistence, resident failure and actual route sorting.
3. **Finding 3 / P07.3:** add kernel SPI Audit Contracts SynchronousAuditWriter, record(AuditEntry, string connectionName): void, and stock DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter. It writes through core's own AuditLog::saveQuietly с явным uniqueIds/newUniqueId in a committed transaction, requires snapshot/no ambient transaction, bypasses optional auditEnabled and queue, and has no dependency on impersonation or AuditLogger. Tenancy DualImpersonationAuditSink uses this public SPI; no foreign Internal. Central event is committed first, tenant mirror second, then session/login. Claim commits separately and remains consumed on failure. There is no distributed atomic rollback: a central intent survives failed/uncertain tenant commit, login is denied. Event outcome names retain attempt semantics and correlation. Stop clears login before audit; login failure clears session before failed event. New SPI/Golden/CHANGELOG, writer factory and real stock persistence/DI tests belong to P07.3, including disabled general audit and async queue. No-op/queued writer violates SPI.
4. **Finding 4 / P07.4:** preserve unreleased bridge semantics by extending both closed stability sets (package-graph-gate and taxonomy) from four to five values; schema-version remains 1. Manifest-check also validates closed enum and allows unreleased only for access-azguard. Add gate/taxonomy to Files and run both gates in P07.4, with mystery/foreign-unreleased negatives. P09 release exclusion/Q2 remains in force.
5. **Finding 6 / P07.3:** regulated atomic UPDATE requires independent approved_by plus correlated EXISTS root_identities.is_staff=true for approver, separately from claimant staff EXISTS. FK/null/self/non-staff cases and claimant demotion are explicit PG cells; no schema change.
6. **Finding 7 / P07.5:** SqlDigestBuilder accepts nullable WakeupScheduler; factory resolves it only when enabled. Enabled + null fails constructor before writes and RuntimeConfigCheck at boot. Disabled explicit build retains existing frozen-digest semantics and never schedules; tags remain enabled-only. Verify boot/resolve/nonempty build without wakeup installed/bound, disabled spy never resolved, enabled missing fails, enabled scheduler works. DigestBuilder SPI unchanged.
7. **Verification/gates:** execute current Markdown code with installed Laravel and stock baseline where possible, retain hashes/negative controls; use isolated in-memory SQLite only for schema-light persistence proofs, never project PostgreSQL. Existing 27 checks remain and do not replace six-defect proofs. Runtime PG/Redis/memcached/full provider acceptance stays in items. Task writers regenerate state/decisions/status; phase finalize-design and whole-plan finish bind current fingerprint. Grok 4.7/high/500k review is technical, not formal frontier/xhigh design audit. No GREEN admission; P06 closure and actual current design gate precede execution. P08/P09 unchanged.

## Why

The old examples could route tenants to central, preserve central auth, enqueue mandatory audit without durability, fail the stability enum, accept a non-staff approver or require an absent scheduler while disabled. These are concrete feasibility/security failures, not optional architecture preferences.
30→
## Consequences

Specs, dossier, examples, Files, Validation and BC delta include these changes. New kernel audit SPI is an additive public SemVer surface; package schema gains one accepted stability value, no aliases. No product code, DB, release, commit or unrelated worktree changes are authorized by this repair. Formal independent frontier/xhigh admission is still outstanding.

10→# D96 — p07-impersonation-access-edges (accepted)

**Actor:** author-choice (designer/claude-code/claude-opus-5-5/high) по мандату B6 и D72.
**Evidence:** RAG:— `artifacts/P07-design/facts/{impersonation,azguard-coupling,package-edges}.txt`, `research/04-architecture.md` §4 и §9, D14, D16, D69 п.7, D70 п.6 и п.9; RAG:✅ `research/P07-design-rag.md` W6–W7 (`pplx-03`, `http-01`).

## Solution

### A. Impersonation (P07.3)

1. **Доменные порты** (не обёртки фреймворка, D70 п.6) в `CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts`, `#[Spi(Implement)]`:
20→   `ImpersonationGrantStore` — `claim(GrantClaim $claim): ?ClaimedGrant` (атомарный однократный захват по правилам профиля) и `claimedReason(string $grantId): ?string`;
   `ImpersonationAuditSink` — `record(ImpersonationAuditEvent $event): void`.
   Штатные реализации: `DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore` (central через `ConnectionResolverInterface`), `DualImpersonationAuditSink` (строка `root_account_events` в central, затем зеркало в tenant через `CoreX\Audit\Contracts\AuditLogger`).
2. Остальные зависимости — контракты фреймворка и ядра: `Illuminate\Contracts\Session\Session` (из текущего запроса в scoped-фабрике), `Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Factory`, `Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher`, `Psr\Clock\ClockInterface`, `CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver` вместо `tenancy()->tenant`. В `packages/tenancy/src/Impersonation/**` нет фасадов, helper-функций и static-состояния; строки Impersonation удаляются из `scripts/runtime-globals-baseline.json` (D70 п.9: baseline обнуляется).
3. **Write-guard**: `ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard` — scoped, `allowing()` — метод экземпляра; слушатели `eloquent.*` разрешают guard из контейнера при каждом событии. Текст `ImpersonationRestrictedException` ссылается на экземплярный `allowing()`.
4. **Профили** `CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Enums\ImpersonationProfile` = `dev|standard|regulated`, ключ `corex-tenancy.impersonation.profile`, default `standard`; заменяет `require_approved_by` без моста (D01).

   | Правило | dev | standard | regulated |
   |:--|:--|:--|:--|
   | `approved_by` | не требуется | не требуется | обязателен и ≠ `staff_identity_id` |
30→   | максимум `expires_at − created_at` | 480 мин | 60 мин | 30 мин |
   | зеркало аудита в tenant | нет | да | да |
   | сбой записи аудита при start | отказ | отказ | отказ |
   | запись моделей под impersonation | запрещена (L1–L3) | запрещена | запрещена |

   Правила профиля проверяются в WHERE атомарного claim (без изменения схемы). `dev` входит в закрытый список опасных режимов D69 п.7: в `production` без `corex.acknowledged_dangerous_modes` содержащего `corex-tenancy.impersonation.profile` → `InvalidConfiguration` (`RuntimeConfigCheck` пакета tenancy).
5. Порядок `start`: claim → аудит `impersonation.started` (central, затем tenant-зеркало; любой сбой → отказ, сессия не открыта, claim остаётся использованным) → session regenerate + ключи → login. Сбой login → очистка сессии + `impersonation.failed`. `stop`: очистка сессии → аудит `impersonation.ended`. Каждое событие аудита содержит grant id, staff id, account id, target user id, reason, профиль, исход и `expires_at` (`pplx-03`).

### B. Access без AzGuard (P07.4)

40→6. `corex-access` не зависит от AzGuard (D14): `AccessChecker::allowed()` вычисляется собственными данными — активное назначение роли принципала в текущем workspace с ненулевым scope в `aut_role_matrix` для `(entity, action)` **или** активный прямой grant в новой tenant-таблице `aut_direct_grants` (`id uuid`, `principal_type`, `principal_id uuid`, `permission_key`, `expires_at nullable`, `revoked_at nullable`, timestamps; индекс по `(principal_type, principal_id, permission_key)`). `RoleMatrixCompiler::compile()` валидирует матрицу и повышает `ScopeMapVersion`, затем диспатчит `RoleMatrixCompiled(roleId)`. `PrincipalIdentity` не реализует AzGuard-контракты. Колонка `aut_roles.azguard_role_id` удаляется из миграции access (D01, правка на месте; baseline — P08).
7. **Мост** `packages/access-azguard` — `axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard`, `CoreX\AccessAzguard\`, тип `bridge`; требует `axiomasoft/corex-access` и `axioma-studio/azguard-core ^0.3`. Переносит в мост: `TenantContextGuard` (AzGuard `ContextGuard`), `WorkspacePermissionLayer`, `AutMatrixGrantSource`, `MatrixPermissionCatalogBuilder`, `AzGuardRoleModel`, синхронизацию `az_guard_role_permissions` по `RoleMatrixCompiled`, связь ролей в таблице моста `aut_azguard_role_links (role_id uuid pk, azguard_role_id bigint)`, AzGuard config pins и Blade-директивы. `extra.corex.stability = "unreleased"`: `scripts/manifest-check.py` принимает это значение только для закрытого списка `UNRELEASED = {"axiomasoft/corex-access-azguard"}`; релизный набор P09 его исключает до публикации стабильного AzGuard (owner-gate Q2). Строка в glossary §Packages.

### C. Рёбра модулей (P07.5)

8. Новый модуль ядра `CoreX\Scheduling` (glossary §Kernel modules) публикует контракты отложенного пробуждения: `Contracts\{WakeupScheduler, DueWakeupSource, DueWakeupHandler}`, `Data\{WakeupRequest, WakeupWindow, WakeupDelivery, WakeupHandlerDefinition, ScheduleResult, CancelResult, SweepResult}`. Пакет `corex-wakeup` их реализует и сохраняет свои `DueWakeupSweeper`, `WakeupScheduleHint`. Перенос — без алиасов (D01).
9. Обработчики пакетов регистрируются тегом `WakeupHandlerDefinition::TAG` (`corex.scheduling.wakeup-handlers`) на биндинге, возвращающем `WakeupHandlerDefinition`; источники — тегом `DueWakeupSource::TAG` (`corex.scheduling.due-sources`). `corex-wakeup` объединяет тегированные определения с `corex-wakeup.handlers` хоста; повтор `kind` → `InvalidConfiguration` при boot. Запись чужого config-ключа (`corex-wakeup.handlers` из notifications) запрещена.
10. `corex-notifications` требует только ядро; digest при `digest_enabled = true` и отсутствии биндинга `WakeupScheduler` → `InvalidConfiguration` (RuntimeConfigCheck notifications), а не тихое отключение. `corex-tasks-workflow` теряет `suggest` на wakeup. `tools → operations` и `webhooks → operations` остаются жёсткими рёбрами: оба пакета регистрируют свои операции в движке operations и без него бессмысленны (D16).
11. `scripts/package-graph-gate.php` в целевом графе: ребро `notifications → wakeup` запрещено; негативный контроль — внесённый импорт `CoreX\Wakeup\` в notifications красит гейт.

50→## Why

A: `pplx-03` — just-in-time grant, short TTL, two correlated audit views, fail-closed; D70 п.9 требует обнулить baseline. B: D14 и AzGuard не опубликован (`http-01`, 404). C: D16 и `research/04` §4 («notifications ↛ wakeup, контракт в ядре»); запись чужого config-ключа — скрытое ребро.

## Consequences

P07.3 — A; P07.4 — B; P07.5 — C. Golden/BC: новые порты и enum (Spi/Api), перенос symbols wakeup в `CoreX\Scheduling`, удаление AzGuard-типов из manifest access, новый пакет — reviewed semantic delta (D64). P08 включает `aut_direct_grants` и `aut_azguard_role_links` в baseline и удаляет `root_accounts.data`.

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Audit\Internal;

use CoreX\Audit\Contracts\SynchronousAuditWriter;
use CoreX\Audit\Data\AuditEntry;
use CoreX\Data\Laravel\JsonDocuments;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use RuntimeException;

/** @internal */
final readonly class DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter implements SynchronousAuditWriter
{
    public function __construct(private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections) {}

    public function record(AuditEntry $entry, string $connectionName): void
    {
        $connection = $this->connections->connection($connectionName);

        if ($connection->transactionLevel() !== 0 || $entry->occurredAt === null) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Synchronous audit requires a snapshot and no ambient transaction');
        }

        $connection->transaction(static function () use ($entry, $connectionName): void {
            $row = new AuditLog([
                'occurred_at' => $entry->occurredAt,
                'actor_type' => $entry->actorType,
                'actor_id' => $entry->actorId,
                'workspace_id' => $entry->workspaceId,
                'entity_type' => $entry->entityType,
                'entity_id' => $entry->entityId,
                'action' => $entry->action,
                'changes' => JsonDocuments::optionalMap($entry->changes),
                'context' => JsonDocuments::map($entry->context),
            ]);
            $row->setConnection($connectionName);

            foreach ($row->uniqueIds() as $column) {
                $row->setAttribute($column, $row->newUniqueId());
            }

            if (! $row->saveQuietly()) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Synchronous audit insert failed');
            }
        });
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal;

use Closure;
use CoreX\Audit\Laravel\AuditWriteExemption;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\ImpersonationService;
use CoreX\Context\Exceptions\ImpersonationRestrictedException;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\Models\ImpersonationGrant;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;

/**
 * L2 — Eloquent layer of the read-only invariant (D141/D142): global
 * wildcard listeners on `eloquent.saving`/`eloquent.deleting`/
 * `eloquent.restoring` reject a write on EVERY model — including ones that
 * do not exist in the tree yet — while an impersonation is active, except
 * the two models a compliance session cannot function without. NOT a
 * hermetic gate (D142, RAG:✅ Laravel 13 `eloquent.md`): mass-update/delete
 * and the `DB` facade never dispatch these events at all; L1 (web) and L3
 * (privileged core services) cover what L2 structurally cannot.
 *
 * @internal spec: B-11 §5.9, D141/D142
 */
final class ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard
{
    /**
     * CLOSED literal, not a config key (D116/D121 — a config-gated exempt
     * list would let the gate be switched off by settings): `AuditLog` so
     * the compliance record itself can be written while `queue=sync` runs
     * it inline; `ImpersonationGrant` because the grant row is the carrier
     * of the session fact itself (its own `used_at`/`revoked_at` writes).
     *
     * @var list<class-string>
     */
    private const EXEMPT = [
        ImpersonationGrant::class,
    ];

    private bool $allowing = false;

    public function __construct(
        private readonly ImpersonationService $impersonation,
    ) {}

    /** @param array<int, mixed> $payload */
    public function handle(string $eventName, array $payload): void
    {
        if ($this->allowing || $this->impersonation->state() === null) {
            return;
        }

        $model = $payload[0] ?? null;

        if (! $model instanceof Model || (in_array($model::class, self::EXEMPT, true) || AuditWriteExemption::permits($model))) {
            return;
        }

        throw ImpersonationRestrictedException::forModelWrite($model::class);
    }

    /**
     * Scoped escape hatch for an intentional write under impersonation
     * (premortem A8/A9) — the flag is reset in `finally` even if `$callback`
     * throws, so a failed intentional write never leaves the guard
     * permanently open for the rest of the request.
     *
     * @template T
     *
     * @param  Closure(): T  $callback
     * @return T
     */
    public function allowing(Closure $callback): mixed
    {
        $previous = $this->allowing;
        $this->allowing = true;

        try {
            return $callback();
        } finally {
            $this->allowing = $previous;
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal;

use CoreX\Context\Contracts\ImpersonationService;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver;
use CoreX\Context\Data\ImpersonationState;
use CoreX\Context\Exceptions\CentralContextException;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Contracts\AccountRead;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Authentication\Exceptions\OidcAuthenticationException;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\ImpersonationAuditSink;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\ImpersonationGrantStore;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Data\GrantClaim;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Data\ImpersonationAuditEvent;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Events\ImpersonationEnded;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Events\ImpersonationStarted;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\ImpersonationPolicy;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Factory as AuthFactory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\StatefulGuard;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Session\Session;
use Override;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;
use Throwable;

/**
 * Cloud implementation of support impersonation (B-11 §5.9, D139). Rebound
 * over the boxed `NullImpersonationService` in `TenancyServiceProvider`
 * under `corex-tenancy.oidc.impersonation.enabled` (D10). `start()`/`stop()`
 * follow research/12 §4 EXACTLY — atomic claim → dual-log mirror BEFORE the
 * session opens (D146) → session state + login; `stop()` reverses the
 * mirror order (session first) because the tenant session, not the audit
 * mirror, is the safety-critical half of the pair.
 *
 * @internal spec: B-11 §5.9, D139/D140/D143/D144/D146
 */
final class DatabaseImpersonationService implements ImpersonationService
{
    private const string SESSION_GRANT_ID = 'corex.impersonation.grant_id';

    private const string SESSION_STAFF_ID = 'corex.impersonation.staff_identity_id';

    private const string SESSION_TARGET_ID = 'corex.impersonation.target_user_id';

    private const string SESSION_EXPIRES_AT = 'corex.impersonation.expires_at';

    private const string SESSION_REASON = 'corex.impersonation.reason';

    /**
     * Request-scoped memo (D139 docblock) — this service is bound as a
     * scoped service, so the container gives one instance per request; `state()`
     * reads the session ONCE and caches the result (or its absence) instead
     * of re-parsing on every {@see CurrentActor} call.
     */
    private bool $resolved = false;

    private ?ImpersonationState $memoState = null;

    public function __construct(
        private ImpersonationPolicy $policy,
        private ImpersonationGrantStore $grants,
        private ImpersonationAuditSink $audit,
        private AccountRead $accounts,
        private TenantContextResolver $contexts,
        private Session $session,
        private AuthFactory $auth,
        private Dispatcher $events,
        private ClockInterface $clock,
        private string $guard,
        private string $centralConnection,
    ) {}

    #[Override]
    public function start(string $grantId, string $staffIdentityId): void
    {
        if (! $this->policy->enabled || $this->state() !== null) {
            throw OidcAuthenticationException::impersonationDenied();
        }

        $accountId = $this->contexts->current()->account->id;
        $claimed = $this->grants->claim(new GrantClaim(
            grantId: $grantId,
            staffIdentityId: $staffIdentityId,
            accountId: $accountId,
            profile: $this->policy->profile,
            now: $this->clock->now(),
        ));

        if ($claimed === null) {
            throw OidcAuthenticationException::impersonationDenied();
        }

        $targetUserId = $claimed->targetUserId ?? $this->accounts->ownerIdentityId($accountId, $this->centralConnection);

        if (! is_string($targetUserId) || $targetUserId === '') {
            throw OidcAuthenticationException::loginFailed();
        }

        $this->record(event: 'impersonation.started', accountId: $accountId, staffIdentityId: $staffIdentityId, grantId: $grantId, targetUserId: $targetUserId, reason: $claimed->reason, expiresAt: $claimed->expiresAt);

        $this->session->regenerate();
        $this->session->put([
            self::SESSION_GRANT_ID => $grantId,
            self::SESSION_STAFF_ID => $staffIdentityId,
            self::SESSION_TARGET_ID => $targetUserId,
            self::SESSION_EXPIRES_AT => $claimed->expiresAt->format(DATE_ATOM),
            self::SESSION_REASON => $claimed->reason,
        ]);

        $this->memoState = new ImpersonationState($grantId, $staffIdentityId, $targetUserId, $claimed->expiresAt, $claimed->reason);
        $this->resolved = true;

        try {
            $authenticated = $this->statefulGuard()->loginUsingId($targetUserId);
        } catch (Throwable) {
            $this->failStart($accountId, $grantId, $staffIdentityId, $targetUserId, $claimed->reason, $claimed->expiresAt);

            throw OidcAuthenticationException::loginFailed();
        }

        if ($authenticated === false) {
            $this->failStart($accountId, $grantId, $staffIdentityId, $targetUserId, $claimed->reason, $claimed->expiresAt);

            throw OidcAuthenticationException::loginFailed();
        }

        $this->events->dispatch(new ImpersonationStarted($grantId, $staffIdentityId, $targetUserId, $claimed->reason));
    }

    #[Override]
    public function stop(): void
    {
        $state = $this->state();

        if ($state === null) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            $accountId = $this->contexts->current()->account->id;
        } catch (CentralContextException) {
            $accountId = null;
        }

        $this->clearSession();

        if ($accountId !== null) {
            $this->record(event: 'impersonation.ended', accountId: $accountId, staffIdentityId: $state->staffIdentityId, grantId: $state->grantId, targetUserId: $state->targetUserId, reason: (string) $state->reason, expiresAt: $state->expiresAt);
        }

        $this->events->dispatch(new ImpersonationEnded($state->grantId, $state->staffIdentityId, $state->targetUserId, (string) $state->reason));
    }

    #[Override]
    public function active(): ?string
    {
        return $this->state()?->grantId;
    }

    #[Override]
    public function state(): ?ImpersonationState
    {
        if ($this->resolved) {
            return $this->memoState;
        }

        $this->resolved = true;

        $grantId = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_GRANT_ID);
        $staffId = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_STAFF_ID);
        $targetId = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_TARGET_ID);
        $expiresAt = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_EXPIRES_AT);

        if (! is_string($grantId) || ! is_string($staffId) || ! is_string($targetId) || ! is_string($expiresAt)) {
            return $this->memoState = null;
        }

        $reason = $this->session->get(self::SESSION_REASON);

        if (! is_string($reason) || $reason === '') {
            $reason = $this->grants->claimedReason($grantId);

            if ($reason === null) {
                $this->clearSession();

                return $this->memoState = null;
            }

            $this->session->put(self::SESSION_REASON, $reason);
        }

        return $this->memoState = new ImpersonationState($grantId, $staffId, $targetId, new DateTimeImmutable($expiresAt), $reason);
    }

    private function failStart(string $accountId, string $grantId, string $staffIdentityId, string $targetUserId, string $reason, DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt): void
    {
        $this->clearSession();
        $this->record(event: 'impersonation.failed', accountId: $accountId, staffIdentityId: $staffIdentityId, grantId: $grantId, targetUserId: $targetUserId, reason: $reason, expiresAt: $expiresAt);
    }

    private function clearSession(): void
    {
        $this->statefulGuard()->logout();
        $this->session->forget([
            self::SESSION_GRANT_ID,
            self::SESSION_STAFF_ID,
            self::SESSION_TARGET_ID,
            self::SESSION_EXPIRES_AT,
            self::SESSION_REASON,
        ]);
        $this->session->invalidate();
        $this->session->regenerateToken();
        $this->memoState = null;
        $this->resolved = true;
    }

    private function record(string $event, string $accountId, string $staffIdentityId, string $grantId, string $targetUserId, string $reason, DateTimeImmutable $expiresAt): void
    {
        $this->audit->record(new ImpersonationAuditEvent(
            event: $event,
            accountId: $accountId,
            grantId: $grantId,
            staffIdentityId: $staffIdentityId,
            targetUserId: $targetUserId,
            reason: $reason,
            profile: $this->policy->profile,
            occurredAt: $this->clock->now(),
            expiresAt: $expiresAt,
        ));
    }

    private function statefulGuard(): StatefulGuard
    {
        $guard = $this->auth->guard($this->guard);

        if (! $guard instanceof StatefulGuard) {
            throw OidcAuthenticationException::loginFailed();
        }

        return $guard;
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal;

use Closure;
use CoreX\Audit\Contracts\SynchronousAuditWriter;
use CoreX\Audit\Data\AuditEntry;
use CoreX\Audit\Enums\ActorType;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver;
use CoreX\Data\Data\JsonDocument;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\ImpersonationAuditSink;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Data\ImpersonationAuditEvent;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use RuntimeException;

/** @internal */
final readonly class DualImpersonationAuditSink implements ImpersonationAuditSink
{
    /** @param Closure(): string $id */
    public function __construct(
        private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections,
        private SynchronousAuditWriter $writer,
        private TenantContextResolver $contexts,
        private Closure $id,
        private string $centralConnection,
    ) {}

    public function record(ImpersonationAuditEvent $event): void
    {
        $context = $this->contexts->current();

        if ($context->account->id !== $event->accountId) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Impersonation audit account mismatch');
        }

        $central = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection);
        $tenant = $event->profile->mirrorsToTenant() ? $this->connections->connection('tenant') : null;

        if ($central->transactionLevel() !== 0 || ($tenant !== null && $tenant->transactionLevel() !== 0)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Impersonation audit forbids ambient transactions');
        }

        $payload = [
            'grant_id' => $event->grantId,
            'account_id' => $event->accountId,
            'staff_identity_id' => $event->staffIdentityId,
            'target_user_id' => $event->targetUserId,
            'reason' => $event->reason,
            'profile' => $event->profile->value,
            'outcome' => $event->event,
            'expires_at' => $event->expiresAt?->format(DATE_ATOM),
        ];

        // Central intent commits first. A failed tenant mirror must not erase it.
        $central->transaction(function () use ($event, $payload, $central): void {
            if (! $central->table('root_account_events')->insert([
                'id' => ($this->id)(),
                'account_id' => $event->accountId,
                'event' => $event->event,
                'actor' => json_encode(['type' => 'support', 'id' => $event->staffIdentityId, 'grant' => $event->grantId], JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
                'payload' => json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR),
                'created_at' => $event->occurredAt,
                'updated_at' => $event->occurredAt,
            ])) {
                throw new RuntimeException('Central impersonation audit insert failed');
            }
        });

        if ($tenant !== null) {
            $this->writer->record(new AuditEntry(
                action: $event->event,
                actorType: ActorType::Support,
                actorId: $event->staffIdentityId,
                entityType: 'impersonation_grant',
                entityId: $event->grantId,
                context: new JsonDocument(json_encode($payload, JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR)),
                occurredAt: $event->occurredAt,
                workspaceId: $context->workspace?->id,
            ), 'tenant');
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal;

use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\ImpersonationGrantStore;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Data\ClaimedGrant;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Data\GrantClaim;
use DateTimeImmutable;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\Query\Builder;
use RuntimeException;

/** @internal */
final readonly class DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore implements ImpersonationGrantStore
{
    public function __construct(private ConnectionResolverInterface $connections, private string $centralConnection) {}

    public function claim(GrantClaim $claim): ?ClaimedGrant
    {
        $central = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection);

        if ($central->transactionLevel() !== 0) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Impersonation claim forbids ambient transactions');
        }

        $affected = $central->table('root_impersonation_grants')
            ->where('id', $claim->grantId)
            ->where('staff_identity_id', $claim->staffIdentityId)
            ->where('account_id', $claim->accountId)
            ->whereNull('used_at')
            ->whereNull('revoked_at')
            ->where('expires_at', '>', $claim->now)
            ->where('reason', '<>', '')
            ->whereRaw(sql: 'expires_at <= created_at + make_interval(mins => ?)', bindings: [$claim->profile->maxGrantMinutes()])
            ->when($claim->profile->requiresIndependentApproval(), static fn (Builder $query) => $query
                ->whereNotNull('approved_by')
                ->whereColumn('approved_by', '<>', 'staff_identity_id')
                ->whereExists(static function (Builder $approved): void {
                    $approved->selectRaw('1')->from('root_identities as approver')
                        ->whereColumn('approver.id', 'root_impersonation_grants.approved_by')
                        ->where('approver.is_staff', true);
                }))
            ->whereExists(static function (Builder $staff) use ($claim): void {
                $staff->selectRaw('1')->from('root_identities as claimant')
                    ->where('claimant.id', $claim->staffIdentityId)
                    ->where('claimant.is_staff', true);
            })
            ->update(['used_at' => $claim->now, 'updated_at' => $claim->now]);

        if ($affected !== 1) {
            return null;
        }

        $row = $central->table('root_impersonation_grants')->where('id', $claim->grantId)->first();

        if ($row === null || ! is_string($row->reason) || $row->reason === '' || ! is_string($row->expires_at)) {
            throw new RuntimeException('Claimed impersonation grant cannot be read');
        }

        return new ClaimedGrant(
            grantId: $claim->grantId,
            targetUserId: is_string($row->target_user_id) ? $row->target_user_id : null,
            reason: $row->reason,
            expiresAt: new DateTimeImmutable($row->expires_at),
        );
    }

    public function claimedReason(string $grantId): ?string
    {
        $reason = $this->connections->connection($this->centralConnection)
            ->table('root_impersonation_grants')
            ->where('id', $grantId)
            ->whereNotNull('used_at')
            ->value('reason');

        return is_string($reason) && $reason !== '' ? $reason : null;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Audit\Data;

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;
use CoreX\Audit\Enums\ActorType;
use CoreX\Context\Data\ImpersonationState;
use CoreX\Data\Data\JsonDocument;
use CoreX\Data\Laravel\JsonDocuments;
use DateTimeImmutable;

/**
 * One append-only audit record. Built by the caller (HasAuditLog trait or
 * CoreX\Audit\Internal\AuditObserver) and handed to AuditLogger::record().
 *
 * `occurredAt`/`workspaceId` are the event-time snapshot: the synchronous
 * path (QueuedAuditLogger::record) stamps them via withSnapshot() while the
 * request's tenant context is still alive — the queue worker only WRITES
 * them, it no longer resolves tenant at write time (an async worker runs
 * under a different — or absent — tenant context and would otherwise stamp a
 * FOREIGN workspace and the write time instead of the event time). The `id`
 * column stays filled at write time (DB-generated).
 */
#[Api(since: '1.0')]
final readonly class AuditEntry
{
    public function __construct(public string $action, public ActorType $actorType, public ?string $actorId = null, public ?string $entityType = null, public ?string $entityId = null, public ?JsonDocument $changes = null, public JsonDocument $context = new JsonDocument('[]'), public ?DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt = null, public ?string $workspaceId = null) {}

    /**
     * Return a copy carrying the event-time snapshot (occurredAt + workspaceId).
     * Stamped on the synchronous enqueue path so the worker writes the moment
     * and tenant of the EVENT, not of the write.
     */
    public function withSnapshot(DateTimeImmutable $occurredAt, ?string $workspaceId): self
    {
        return new self(
            action: $this->action,
            actorType: $this->actorType,
            actorId: $this->actorId,
            entityType: $this->entityType,
            entityId: $this->entityId,
            changes: JsonDocuments::nullable($this->changes),
            context: JsonDocuments::capture($this->context),
            occurredAt: $occurredAt,
            workspaceId: $workspaceId,
        );
    }

    /**
     * Return a copy whose actor and reserved impersonation context come from
     * authority. Caller context is preserved except `impersonation`, which
     * cannot spoof grant, target, or reason. Snapshot fields already present
     * are kept so either copy order yields the full entry.
     */
    public function withImpersonation(ImpersonationState $state): self
    {
        return new self(
            action: $this->action,
            actorType: ActorType::Support,
            actorId: $state->staffIdentityId,
            entityType: $this->entityType,
            entityId: $this->entityId,
            changes: JsonDocuments::nullable($this->changes),
            context: JsonDocuments::capture([
                ...array_diff_key(JsonDocuments::map($this->context), ['impersonation' => true]),
                'impersonation' => [
                    'grant' => $state->grantId,
                    'target_user_id' => $state->targetUserId,
                    'reason' => $state->reason,
                ],
            ]),
            occurredAt: $this->occurredAt,
            workspaceId: $this->workspaceId,
        );
    }
}

use CoreX\Audit\Internal\CurrentActor;
use CoreX\Audit\Internal\DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter;
use CoreX\Config\Data\CoreOptions;
use CoreX\Config\Laravel\ConfiguredImplementation;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\ImpersonationService;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\PackageRegistrar;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Factory as AuthFactory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Http\Request;
use Override;

/** Composition of the kernel module; the public provider delegates here. */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class AuditRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        $app->scoped(AuditLogger::class, static fn (Application $app): AuditLogger => ConfiguredImplementation::resolve($app, AuditLogger::class, $app->make(CoreOptions::class)->auditLogger));
        $app->scoped(SynchronousAuditWriter::class, static fn (Application $app): SynchronousAuditWriter => new DatabaseSynchronousAuditWriter($app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class)));
        $app->scoped(CurrentActor::class, static fn (Application $app): CurrentActor => new CurrentActor(
            auth: $app->make(AuthFactory::class),
            impersonation: $app->make(ImpersonationService::class),
            request: static fn (): ?Request => $app->runningInConsole() || ! $app->bound('request') ? null : $app->make(Request::class),
        ));
        $app->scoped(AuditObserver::class);
        $app->singleton(AuditRetention::class, static fn (Application $app): AuditRetention => ConfiguredImplementation::resolve($app, AuditRetention::class, $app->make(CoreOptions::class)->auditRetention));
    }

    #[Override]
    public function boot(Application $app): void {}
}

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;

#[Api(since: '1.0')]
enum ImpersonationProfile: string
{
    case Dev = 'dev';
    case Standard = 'standard';
    case Regulated = 'regulated';

    public function maxGrantMinutes(): int
    {
        return match ($this) {
            self::Dev => 480,
            self::Standard => 60,
            self::Regulated => 30,
        };
    }

    public function requiresIndependentApproval(): bool
    {
        return $this === self::Regulated;
    }

    public function mirrorsToTenant(): bool
    {
        return $this !== self::Dev;
    }
}

/**
 * Append-only audit entry (sys_audit_log). No updated_at:
 * DB_SCHEMA.md §Конфликт-2 (resolved 2026-07-13) — an append-only class
 * keeps updated_at only if it has ≥1 legitimate post-insert field; this

 * @property ActorType $actor_type
 * @property string|null $actor_id
 * @property string|null $workspace_id
 * @property string|null $entity_type
 * @property string|null $entity_id

        return [
            'occurred_at' => 'immutable_datetime',
            'actor_type' => ActorType::class,
            'changes' => 'array',
            'context' => 'array',

    }

namespace CoreX\Context\Exceptions;

use CoreX\Attributes\Api;
use CoreX\Context\Enums\ImpersonationRestrictedAction;
use CoreX\Errors\Data\ErrorDescriptor;
use CoreX\Errors\Enums\CoreErrorCode;
use CoreX\Errors\Enums\ErrorCategory;
use CoreX\Errors\Exceptions\CodedException;

/**
 * Thrown by any of the three read-only-invariant layers (D141) when an
 * impersonated session attempts a write the layer does not recognize as
 * explicitly allowed. Named constructors point at the exact escape hatch
 * for the layer that raised it — a bare "write blocked" message would leave
 * the premortem A8/A9 diagnosis (route marker vs `allowing()` scope) to
 * guesswork.
 */
#[Api(since: '1.0')]
final class ImpersonationRestrictedException extends CodedException
{
    private function __construct(string $message)
    {
        parent::__construct($message);
    }

    /** L2 — `CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard` (axiomasoft/corex-tenancy; named, not `{@see}`-linked — core must not import it, D91). */
    public static function forModelWrite(string $modelClass): self
    {
        return new self(
            "Model write blocked under impersonation: {$modelClass}. ".
            'Use the current scoped ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard instance allowing() method for an intentional mutation.',
        );
    }

    /** L3 — {@see CoreX\Context\Internal\ImpersonationGuard::assertAllowed()}. */
    public static function forAction(ImpersonationRestrictedAction $action): self
    {
        return new self(
            "Action restricted under impersonation: {$action->name} (B-11 §5.9 п.3).",
        );
    }

    public function errorDescriptor(): ErrorDescriptor
    {
        return new ErrorDescriptor(CoreErrorCode::ImpersonationRestrictedException, ErrorCategory::Authorization, retryable: false);
    }
}

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Audit\Contracts\SynchronousAuditWriter;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\ImpersonationService;

use CoreX\Tenancy\Authentication\Internal\Http\Controllers\OidcLoginController;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Authentication\Internal\Oidc\IdTokenVerifier;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Authentication\Internal\Oidc\JwksKeySet;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Authentication\Internal\Oidc\OidcClient;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Authentication\Internal\Oidc\OidcDiscovery;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Identity\Contracts\IdentitySyncer;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\ImpersonationAuditSink;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Contracts\ImpersonationGrantStore;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\DatabaseImpersonationService;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\DualImpersonationAuditSink;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\ImpersonationPolicy;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Auth\Factory as AuthFactory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Cache\Factory as CacheFactory;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Http\Client\Factory as HttpFactory;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;
use Override;
use Psr\Clock\ClockInterface;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class AuthenticationRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    use RegistersNothingOnBoot;

    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        $app->scoped(
            ImpersonationGrantStore::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ImpersonationGrantStore => new DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore(
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->scoped(
            ImpersonationAuditSink::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ImpersonationAuditSink => new DualImpersonationAuditSink(
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                writer: $app->make(SynchronousAuditWriter::class),
                contexts: $app->make(TenantContextResolver::class),
                id: static fn (): string => (string) Str::uuid7(),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            OidcDiscovery::class,
            static fn (Application $app): OidcDiscovery => new OidcDiscovery(
                http: $app->make(HttpFactory::class),
                cache: $app->make(CacheFactory::class),
                issuer: (string) $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcIssuer,
                cacheStore: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcDiscoveryCacheStore,
                cacheTtl: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcDiscoveryCacheTtl,
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            JwksKeySet::class,
            static fn (Application $app): JwksKeySet => new JwksKeySet(
                http: $app->make(HttpFactory::class),
                cache: $app->make(CacheFactory::class),
                cacheStore: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcJwksCacheStore,
                cacheTtl: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcJwksCacheTtl,
                refetchCooldownSeconds: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcJwksRefetchCooldownSeconds,
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            IdTokenVerifier::class,
            static fn (Application $app): IdTokenVerifier => new IdTokenVerifier(
                jwks: $app->make(JwksKeySet::class),
                issuer: (string) $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcIssuer,
                clientId: (string) $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcClientId,
                allowedAlgs: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcAllowedAlgs,
                leewaySeconds: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcLeewaySeconds,
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            OidcClient::class,
            static fn (Application $app): OidcClient => new OidcClient(
                http: $app->make(HttpFactory::class),
                discovery: $app->make(OidcDiscovery::class),
                clientId: (string) $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcClientId,
                clientSecret: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcClientSecret?->reveal(),
                redirectUri: (string) $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcRedirectUri,
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            LogoutController::class,
            static fn (Application $app): LogoutController => new LogoutController(
                auth: $app->make(AuthFactory::class),
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                clock: $app->make(ClockInterface::class),
                options: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class),
            ),
        );
        $app->scoped(
            OidcLoginController::class,
            static fn (Application $app): OidcLoginController => new OidcLoginController(
                discovery: $app->make(OidcDiscovery::class),
                client: $app->make(OidcClient::class),
                verifier: $app->make(IdTokenVerifier::class),
                syncer: $app->make(IdentitySyncer::class),
                impersonation: $app->make(ImpersonationService::class),
                impersonationPolicy: $app->make(ImpersonationPolicy::class),
                options: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class),
                auth: $app->make(AuthFactory::class),
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                clock: $app->make(ClockInterface::class),
                contexts: $app->make(TenantContextResolver::class),
            ),
        );

        // P2.11 (D139/D10) — rebind the boxed NullImpersonationService
        // to the cloud implementation whenever the OIDC lane itself is
        // active; DatabaseImpersonationService::start() is only ever
        // reached when `oidc.impersonation.enabled` ALSO gates it open
        // (OidcLoginController::impersonationClaim()) — binding it here
        // unconditionally within this block just means the container
        // has something to resolve for OidcLoginController's
        // constructor regardless of that inner sub-flag.
        $app->scoped(
            ImpersonationService::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseImpersonationService => new DatabaseImpersonationService(
                policy: $app->make(ImpersonationPolicy::class),
                grants: $app->make(ImpersonationGrantStore::class),
                audit: $app->make(ImpersonationAuditSink::class),
                accounts: $app->make(AccountRead::class),
                contexts: $app->make(TenantContextResolver::class),
                session: $app->make('request')->hasSession()
                    ? $app->make('request')->session()
                    : $app->make('session.store'),
                auth: $app->make(AuthFactory::class),
                events: $app->make(Dispatcher::class),
                clock: $app->make(ClockInterface::class),
                guard: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->oidcGuard,
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Data\GrantClaim;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Enums\ImpersonationProfile;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Tests\TestCase;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\DB;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

uses(TestCase::class);

it('enforces all 27 grant profile matrix cells in the atomic claim', function (): void {
    DB::statement('DROP SCHEMA IF EXISTS public CASCADE');
    DB::statement('CREATE SCHEMA public');
    DB::purge('pgsql');
    test()->artisan('migrate', [
        '--database' => 'pgsql',
        '--path' => realpath(__DIR__.'/../../database/migrations/root'),
        '--realpath' => true,
        '--force' => true,
    ])->run();

    $central = DB::connection('pgsql');
    $staffId = (string) Str::uuid();
    $approverId = (string) Str::uuid();
    $nonStaffId = (string) Str::uuid();
    $ownerId = (string) Str::uuid();
    foreach ([$staffId => true, $approverId => true, $nonStaffId => false, $ownerId => false] as $id => $staff) {
        $central->table('root_identities')->insert(['id' => $id, 'email' => $id.'@test.invalid', 'is_staff' => $staff]);
    }

    $clusterId = (string) Str::uuid();
    $accountId = (string) Str::uuid();
    $central->table('root_clusters')->insert([
        'id' => $clusterId, 'name' => 'profile-test', 'pg_host_writer' => 'localhost',
        'pgbouncer_host' => 'localhost', 'app_db_user' => 'corex',
    ]);
    $central->table('root_accounts')->insert([
        'id' => $accountId, 'cluster_id' => $clusterId, 'db_name' => 'profile_test',
        'status' => 'active', 'slug' => 'profile-test', 'owner_identity_id' => $ownerId,
        'template_version' => 1, 'embedding_model' => 'bge-m3', 'embedding_dim' => 1024,
    ]);

    $cases = [
        ['minutes' => 45, 'approver' => null, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, true, false]],
        ['minutes' => 45, 'approver' => $approverId, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, true, false]],
        ['minutes' => 20, 'approver' => $approverId, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, true, true]],
        ['minutes' => 20, 'approver' => $staffId, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, true, false]],
        ['minutes' => 20, 'approver' => $nonStaffId, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, true, false]],
        ['minutes' => 20, 'approver' => null, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, true, false]],
        ['minutes' => 20, 'approver' => $approverId, 'staff' => false, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [false, false, false]],
        ['minutes' => 120, 'approver' => null, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => 'ticket', 'accepted' => [true, false, false]],
        ['minutes' => 20, 'approver' => null, 'staff' => true, 'reason' => '', 'accepted' => [false, false, false]],
    ];
    $store = new DatabaseImpersonationGrantStore(connections: app(ConnectionResolverInterface::class), centralConnection: 'pgsql');
    $assertions = 0;

    foreach ($cases as $case) {
        $central->table('root_identities')->where('id', $staffId)->update(['is_staff' => $case['staff']]);
        foreach (ImpersonationProfile::cases() as $index => $profile) {
            $now = now()->toDateTimeImmutable();
            $grantId = (string) Str::uuid();
            $central->table('root_impersonation_grants')->insert([
                'id' => $grantId, 'staff_identity_id' => $staffId, 'account_id' => $accountId,
                'reason' => $case['reason'], 'approved_by' => $case['approver'],
                'created_at' => $now, 'expires_at' => $now->modify('+'.$case['minutes'].' minutes'),
            ]);
            $claimed = $store->claim(new GrantClaim(grantId: $grantId, staffIdentityId: $staffId, accountId: $accountId, profile: $profile, now: $now));
            expect($claimed !== null)->toBe($case['accepted'][$index]);
            expect($central->table('root_impersonation_grants')->where('id', $grantId)->value('used_at') !== null)
                ->toBe($case['accepted'][$index]);
            $assertions++;
        }
    }

    expect($assertions)->toBe(27);
})->group('pg');

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Database\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Config\Data\CoreOptions;
use CoreX\Database\Enums\IdStrategy;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Support\Str;

/**
 * Config-driven primary key: UUIDv7 (default, per ADR-003), UUID, ULID, or
 * auto-increment int — per config('corex.ids.strategy'). A single seam so a
 * host app can line CoreX models up with its own key type without forking
 * the package (mirrors AzGuard's configurable morph key). Pair with
 * CoreX\Database\Laravel\IdColumns in migrations so the column type matches.
 */
#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
trait HasConfiguredId
{
    public static function bootHasConfiguredId(): void
    {
        static::creating(function (Model $model): void {
            if (app(CoreOptions::class)->idStrategy === IdStrategy::Int) {
                return;
            }

            foreach ($model->uniqueIds() as $column) {
                if (empty($model->getAttribute($column))) {
                    $model->setAttribute($column, $model->newUniqueId());
                }
            }
        });
    }

    /**
     * Columns that receive a generated id. Empty for the int strategy
     * (the database auto-increments).
     *
     * @return list<string>
     */
    public function uniqueIds(): array
    {
        return app(CoreOptions::class)->idStrategy === IdStrategy::Int ? [] : [$this->getKeyName()];
    }

    public function newUniqueId(): string
    {
        return match (app(CoreOptions::class)->idStrategy) {
            IdStrategy::Uuid7 => (string) Str::uuid7(),
            IdStrategy::Uuid => (string) Str::orderedUuid(),
            default => (string) Str::ulid(),
        };
    }

    public function getKeyType(): string
    {
        return app(CoreOptions::class)->idStrategy === IdStrategy::Int ? 'int' : 'string';
    }

    public function getIncrementing(): bool
    {
        return app(CoreOptions::class)->idStrategy === IdStrategy::Int;
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\PackageRegistrar;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Internal\Models\Account;
use CoreX\Tenancy\DomainTrust\Internal\Models\Domain;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\HostResolverCacheInvalidator;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\QueueTenantContext;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Events\Dispatcher;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobAttempted;
use Illuminate\Queue\Events\JobProcessing;
use Override;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class EventsRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void {}

    #[Override]
    public function boot(Application $app): void
    {
        $options = $app->make(TenancyOptions::class);
        $events = $app->make(Dispatcher::class);

        // Resolved from the container per event: QueueTenantContext is a singleton frame stack.
        // JobAttempted (dispatched from the `finally` of Worker::process and SyncQueue::executeJob)
        // is the only point that ends a job's context.
        $events->listen(JobProcessing::class, [QueueTenantContext::class, 'processing']);
        $events->listen(JobAttempted::class, [QueueTenantContext::class, 'finished']);

        // Host → account entries are forgotten before a model's rows go away, and after any save.
        // The invalidator itself is a no-op while host identification or its cache is off.
        $events->listen('eloquent.saved: '.Account::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'accountChanged']);
        $events->listen('eloquent.deleting: '.Account::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'accountChanged']);
        $events->listen('eloquent.saved: '.Domain::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'domainChanged']);
        $events->listen('eloquent.deleting: '.Domain::class, [HostResolverCacheInvalidator::class, 'domainChanged']);

        // Wildcard listeners stay inside the OIDC block: impersonation can be
        // configured while OIDC is off, and that profile registers nothing.
        if ($options->oidcEnabled && $options->impersonation->enabled) {
            // Resolve per event. A captured instance would keep the first
            // request's scoped impersonation service in a long-lived worker.
            $events->listen('eloquent.saving: *', [ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class, 'handle']);
            $events->listen('eloquent.deleting: *', [ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class, 'handle']);
            $events->listen('eloquent.restoring: *', [ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class, 'handle']);
        }
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel;

use CoreX\Attributes\Spi;
use CoreX\Attributes\SpiKind;
use CoreX\Config\Contracts\RuntimeConfigCheck;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\AccountConnectionResolver;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenancyManager;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextResolver;
use CoreX\Context\Contracts\TenantContextRestorer;
use CoreX\Modules\Contracts\PackageRegistrar;
use CoreX\Storage\Contracts\TenantStorage;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Account\Contracts\AccountRead;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Impersonation\Internal\ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Internal\DangerousModesCheck;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\AccountLifecyclePolicy;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\ImpersonationPolicy;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\StatusGatePolicy;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Laravel\Support\TenancyOptions;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\Database\TemplateClonePostgreSQLManager;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Provisioning\Internal\Database\TemplateIntegrityVerifier;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Bootstrappers\CachePrefixBootstrapper;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Bootstrappers\ConnectionBootstrapper;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Bootstrappers\SessionConnectionBootstrapper;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\CentralTemplateConnectionResolver;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\ConnectionGuardedTenantContextRestorer;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\DatabaseTenancyManager;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\FrameworkConfig;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\QueueTenantContext;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\Storage\ContextTenantStorage;
use CoreX\Tenancy\Runtime\Internal\TenancyManagerContextResolver;
use Illuminate\Cache\CacheManager;
use Illuminate\Contracts\Foundation\Application;
use Illuminate\Database\ConnectionResolverInterface;
use Illuminate\Database\DatabaseManager;
use Illuminate\Filesystem\FilesystemManager;
use Illuminate\Queue\QueueManager;
use Illuminate\Session\SessionManager;
use Override;

#[Spi(kind: SpiKind::Call, since: '1.0')]
final class RuntimeRegistrar implements PackageRegistrar
{
    #[Override]
    public function register(Application $app): void
    {
        // Lazy singleton, never instance(): materializing TenancyOptions here would
        // validate OIDC before Testbench fills it; the provider resolves it in boot().
        $app->singleton(
            TenancyOptions::class,
            static fn (Application $app): TenancyOptions => TenancyOptions::fromArray(
                config: self::tenancySection($app),
            ),
        );
        $app->bind(
            ImpersonationPolicy::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ImpersonationPolicy => $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->impersonation,
        );
        $app->scoped(ImpersonatedModelWriteGuard::class);
        $app->tag([DangerousModesCheck::class], RuntimeConfigCheck::class);
        $app->bind(
            AccountLifecyclePolicy::class,
            static fn (Application $app): AccountLifecyclePolicy => $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->lifecycle,
        );
        $app->bind(
            StatusGatePolicy::class,
            static fn (Application $app): StatusGatePolicy => $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->statusGate,
        );

        $app->singleton(
            FrameworkConfig::class,
            static fn (): FrameworkConfig => TenancyRuntimeFactory::frameworkConfig(),
        );

        $app->bindIf(
            AccountConnectionResolver::class,
            static fn (Application $app): AccountConnectionResolver => new CentralTemplateConnectionResolver(
                connections: $app->make(ConnectionResolverInterface::class),
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            ConnectionBootstrapper::class,
            static fn (Application $app): ConnectionBootstrapper => new ConnectionBootstrapper(
                databases: $app->make(DatabaseManager::class),
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            CachePrefixBootstrapper::class,
            static fn (Application $app): CachePrefixBootstrapper => new CachePrefixBootstrapper(
                cache: $app->make(CacheManager::class),
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                stores: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->cacheStores,
                prefix: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->cachePrefix,
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
            ),
        );
        $app->singleton(
            SessionConnectionBootstrapper::class,
            static fn (Application $app): SessionConnectionBootstrapper => new SessionConnectionBootstrapper(
                sessions: $app->make(SessionManager::class),
                cache: $app->make(CacheManager::class),
                container: $app,
                config: $app->make(FrameworkConfig::class),
                centralConnection: $app->make(TenancyOptions::class)->centralConnection,
                files: $app->make('files'),
            ),
        );

        $app->singleton(
            DatabaseTenancyManager::class,
            static fn (Application $app): DatabaseTenancyManager => TenancyRuntimeFactory::manager($app),
        );

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace CoreX\Tenancy\Identity\Internal\Models;

use Carbon\CarbonImmutable;
use CoreX\Database\Laravel\HasConfiguredId;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Model;
use Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes;
use Illuminate\Support\Carbon;

/**
 * Tenant-DB projection of `root_identities` (B-11 §2.2, full denorm D4/C6).
 * Cannot extend `CoreX\Database\Laravel\BaseModel` (its own docblock carves out
 * exactly this case): `id` is external (= root_identities.id, no generated
 * default) — {@see HasConfiguredId} would fight that.
 *
 * @property string $id
 * @property string $email
 * @property string $name
 * @property ?string $phone
 * @property string $locale
 * @property ?string $password_hash
 * @property ?string $department_id
 * @property bool $is_active
 * @property array<string, mixed> $settings
 * @property ?Carbon $last_login_at
 * @property ?Carbon $synced_at
 * @property ?CarbonImmutable $identity_source_updated_at
 */
final class User extends Model
{
    use SoftDeletes;

    public $incrementing = false;

    protected $keyType = 'string';

    protected $dateFormat = 'Y-m-d H:i:s.u';

    protected $hidden = [
        'password_hash',
    ];

    protected $fillable = [
        'id',
        'email',
        'name',
        'phone',
        'locale',
        'department_id',
        'is_active',
        'settings',
        'last_login_at',
        'synced_at',
        'identity_source_updated_at',
    ];

    protected $casts = [
        'is_active' => 'boolean',
        'settings' => 'array',
        'last_login_at' => 'datetime',
        'synced_at' => 'datetime',
        'identity_source_updated_at' => 'immutable_datetime',
    ];
}
